_comment: Enterprise demo only (DEMO-PLAN section 16). The marketer's 'Tailor resume for this job' story, preset for ONE job and ONE consultant. The web sheet shows these changes and scores; web/scripts/demo-setup.mjs builds the tailored resume (PDF) from the same text, so what the audience sees is what gets attached. Nothing here is computed by an AI.

job.title: ML Platform Engineer
job.keyInfo: Northbeam's recommendations team needs a platform engineer for its training and serving stack on EKS. Contract-to-hire, remote.

resume.label: Anika Rao - ML Platform Engineer (Northbeam Media)
resume.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Data & ML Infrastructure

changes.after: Senior Platform Engineer, Data & ML Infrastructure
changes.why: The job title says ML platform; her headline now leads with the same words.

changes.before: Platform and data engineer with 8 years building the infrastructure that product and analytics teams depend on. I design reliable data pipelines in Python and SQL, run them on AWS with Kubernetes and Terraform, and own their monitoring and on-call. I like turning fragile, manual systems into well-tested platforms other engineers enjoy using, and I work closely with product, analytics and security teams to ship them.
changes.after: Platform engineer with 8 years building the infrastructure that data and machine-learning teams depend on. I run Python workloads on AWS with Kubernetes and Terraform, build the Airflow pipelines that feed analytics and model training, and own their monitoring, SLOs and on-call. I turn fragile, manual systems into well-tested self-service platforms, working closely with product, data science and security teams.
changes.why: Same facts, reordered for an ML platform reader: training pipelines and data science partners up front.

changes.before: Lead a team of 4 running the AWS EKS data platform: 120+ Airflow pipelines serving 6 product teams.
changes.after: Lead a team of 4 running the AWS EKS platform for data and ML workloads: 120+ Airflow pipelines feeding analytics and model training for 6 product teams.
changes.why: Names the ML workloads she already runs, using the job's own words.

changes.before: Built a self-service CI/CD template on GitHub Actions and Argo CD, used by 30 services.
changes.after: Built a self-service CI/CD and deployment template (GitHub Actions, Argo CD) used by 30 services, including the team's model-serving APIs.
changes.why: Model serving is a must-have in the posting; this bullet already covers it.

changes.before: Moved legacy cron jobs to Airflow on Kubernetes; on-time daily reports rose from 85% to 99.5%.
changes.after: Orchestrated batch workloads with Airflow on Kubernetes (replacing legacy cron); on-time delivery rose from 85% to 99.5%.
changes.why: Puts orchestration first; the result stays exactly as she wrote it.

changes.before: Cloud · Infrastructure · Data Engineering · CI/CD · Reliability · Programming
changes.after: Infrastructure · Data & ML · Cloud · CI/CD · Reliability · Programming
changes.why: Her Kubernetes and pipeline skills move to the top; nothing is added here.
